queries: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON ab.translink = tx.transreg JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM type_counts), scored AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM scored WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.transaction_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.value;
